edges.reason: src parameter flows into trade() trade execution.
srcAmount parameter flows into trade().
dest parameter flows into trade().
destAddress parameter flows into trade().
maxDestAmount parameter clamps the executed amount in trade().
minConversionRate parameter enforces a rate floor in trade().
rate100 parameter overrides the rate for code-validated tokens.
sn parameter is passed from trade() into input validation.
code parameter is passed from trade() into input validation.
supplier parameter is pushed into the suppliers array.
add flag selects add or remove branch in addSupplier().
user parameter selects whose balance is read.
srcQty parameter is forwarded to supplier rate queries.
amount parameter controls the supplier.callValue and transferFrom amount.
conversionRate parameter is forwarded to the supplier call.
newAdmin parameter writes pendingAdmin.
newOperator parameter writes the operators mapping and group.
token parameter is the ERC20 targeted for rescue.
sendTo parameter is the transfer recipient in withdrawToken().
actualDestAmount computed in doTrade() is returned and required > 0 in trade().
actualSrcAmount local drives refund and supplier call inside doTrade().
rate local is selected and consumed inside doTrade().
userSrcBalanceBefore snapshot is passed to checkBalance().
callValue local is forwarded as the supplier call value.
msg.sender is used as token owner and destination of refunds in trade().
fallback requires isSupplier[msg.sender] before accepting ether.
claimAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
msg.sender is the from-address of src.transferFrom in doSupplierTrade().
trade() calls validateTradeInput() before executing.
trade() delegates execution to doTrade().
trade() calls checkBalance() after doTrade().
doTrade() calls findBestRate() to select supplier and rate.
doTrade() calls doSupplierTrade() to execute the swap.
doTrade() calls calcDestAmount() for the destination amount.
doTrade() calls calcSrcAmount() when clamping to maxDestAmount.
doTrade() calls getUserCapInWei() to enforce the user cap.
calcDestAmount reaches the unchecked multiplication in calcDstQty.
calcSrcAmount reaches the unchecked multiplication in calcSrcQty.
doSupplierTrade() makes the external supplier.trade.value() call before final balance reconciliation.
doTrade() refunds leftover ether to msg.sender.
doSupplierTrade() transfers ether to destAddress.
doSupplierTrade() transfers dest tokens to destAddress.
doSupplierTrade() pulls src tokens via transferFrom.
listPairForSupplier() issues token approvals to suppliers.
withdrawToken() performs token.transfer to the recipient.
withdrawEther() performs sendTo.transfer.
findBestRate() uses blockhash(block.number-1) as a randomness source.
A malicious supplier can reenter trade() during the external call before state is settled.
Supplier callback can reenter doSupplierTrade() flow before dest transfers complete.
